title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 2020 Work Priorities of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 2020 Work Points of the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2020] No. 5

To: All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The 2020 Work Points of the People's Courts are hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

February 3, 2020

2020 Work Points of the People's Courts

The year 2020 is the final year for completing the building of a moderately prosperous society in all respects and for concluding the 13th Five-Year Plan. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, the Central Economic Work Conference, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs. They must strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," fortify the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." They must uphold the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, unswervingly implement the new development philosophy, and closely focus on the goal of "striving to let the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case." They must adhere to the main line of justice for the people and impartial justice, always prioritize the safeguarding of national political security, comprehensively deepen judicial system reform and the construction of smart courts, deeply advance the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, vigorously strengthen the building of a competent team, accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capability, better perform the trial function, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for sustaining healthy economic development and overall social stability, as well as for successfully completing the building of a moderately prosperous society and the 13th Five-Year Plan.

I. Persistently Strengthen Theoretical Armament and Always Use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to Arm the Mind, Guide Practice, and Drive Work

1. Promote the Study and Implementation of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to Go Deeper, Enter the Heart, and be Practiced. Adhere to proactive study, timely study, study in the context of the overall situation, study in connection with reality, study with problems in mind, and study with firm faith and action. Organize hierarchical and comprehensive political training, consolidate and expand the achievements of the "Never Forget the Original Intention, Keep the Mission in Mind" education campaign, and educate and guide judicial officers to continuously strengthen scientific theoretical armament. Deeply study and implement the guiding principles of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee, accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capability, solidly advance serving the overall situation, justice for the people, and impartial justice, and based on judicial functions, promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability. Deeply study and implement the important speech of General Secretary Xi Jinping when he presided over a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee to hear the work report of the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, effectively enhance the consciousness and firmness of "Two Upholds," closely fulfill duties and responsibilities around the task of completing the building of a moderately prosperous society, steadily advance judicial system reform, consolidate the main responsibility for strictly governing the Party in all respects, and strengthen the Party building and team building of the people's courts. Deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important directives on political and legal work, study and implement the guiding principles of the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs, and accurately identify the points of integration and focus for judicial work to serve the overall situation.

2. Implement Party Leadership in All Fields, Aspects, and Links of the Work of the People's Courts. Firmly uphold the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, ensure that the "Four Consciousnesses," "Four Confidences," and "Two Upholds" are implemented in the judicial field, and always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in terms of political stance, political direction, political principles, and political path. Thoroughly implement the "Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Reporting Major Matters," strictly observe political discipline and political rules, conscientiously handle the work of reporting major matters, and ensure that the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee are implemented without compromise. Thoroughly implement the "Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Political and Legal Work," improve the institutional system for the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, persist in promoting the implementation of the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments in judicial work through legal procedures, and ensure that orders from the Party Central Committee are carried out and policies are unimpeded.

3. Unswervingly Take the Path of Socialist Rule of Law with Chinese Characteristics. Adhere to the organic unity of Party leadership, the people being the masters of the country, and governing the country according to law, faithfully fulfill the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, and highlight the significant institutional advantages of ensuring social fairness and justice and people's rights. Conscientiously implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's new concepts, new ideas, and new strategies on comprehensively governing the country according to law, adhere to and improve the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, place the construction of the judicial system and judicial governance capacity in a more prominent position, and strive to make the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics more mature and more established. Adhere to the unity of Party leadership and the independent and impartial exercise of adjudicative power according to law, unify the emphasis on politics and the emphasis on law, and better transform the advantages of Party leadership into judicial governance effectiveness.

II. Firmly Establish a Holistic View of National Security and Safeguard National Security and Social Stability

4. Firmly Establish Criminal Justice Concepts Adapted to the New Era. From the height of maintaining long-term national stability and consolidating the Party's ruling foundation, deeply understand the function of criminal adjudication, proactively respond to realistic concerns, attach importance to the demonstrative role of judgments, and better serve sustained healthy economic development and overall social stability. Accurately apply the law, take into account national law, natural justice, and human feelings, adhere to the unity of punishing crime and protecting human rights, coordinate fairness and efficiency, respect the people's simple emotions and concept of justice, and defend social fairness and justice through strict and impartial justice. Accurately understand the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, precisely apply penalties, treat differently, and distinguish between minor and serious cases, achieving leniency when lenient, severity when severe, combining leniency with severity, and ensuring the punishment fits the crime. Unswervingly adhere to the Party's and the state's death penalty policy, resolutely impose the death penalty according to law on a very small number of extremely serious criminals, correctly apply the system of mediation in criminal cases with civil actions, and prevent misunderstandings such as "buying life with money" or "buying lighter sentences with money" from arising in society.

5. Deeply Carry Out the Special Campaign to Combat Gang Crimes and Evil Forces. Adhere to strict handling of cases according to law, always take facts as the basis and law as the criterion, resolutely prevent artificial "upgrading" or "downgrading," and ensure that every case can withstand the test of law and history. Accurately grasp the new situation and new tasks of the stage in combating gang crimes and evil forces, closely focus on the trial of major cases involving organized crime and evil forces, intensify efforts to "break the umbrellas and tear the nets" and "cut off the financial lifeline and destroy the blood vessels," strengthen governance at the source, highlight treating both symptoms and root causes, ensure thorough and complete elimination, and promote the achievement of "long-term and regular governance." Hold on to the three-year target without relaxation, accelerate the process of lawfully adjudicating cases related to organized crime and evil forces, and promote a comprehensive victory in the special campaign.

6. Strictly Punish All Types of Criminal Offenses According to Law. Severely crack down on various crimes of infiltration, subversion, destruction, violent terrorism, ethnic separatism, and religious extremism, and fully safeguard national political security. Lawfully punish corruption crimes, accurately apply the system of trial in absentia, and promote the deepening of the anti-corruption struggle. Strictly punish all types of serious violent crimes, multiple property crimes, and crimes endangering food and drug safety, severely punish crimes against left-behind women and children, crimes endangering campus safety, crimes obstructing public transportation safety, and telecom and online fraud, and resolutely protect the safety of people's lives and property.

7. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Human Rights. Strictly follow the principles of no punishment without law, proportionality between crime and punishment, and equality before the law, adhere to the principle of innocent until proven guilty and evidence-based adjudication, and ensure fair conviction, fair sentencing, and fair procedure. Fully protect the defendant and their defense counsel in exercising their litigation rights according to law, respect and guarantee lawyers in performing their duties according to law, and promote the pilot program of full coverage of lawyer defense. Insist on respecting and protecting human rights throughout the criminal trial process, further reverse the concepts of emphasizing strike over protection and substantive law over procedural law, and ensure lawful punishment of crime and protection of human rights.

8. Conscientiously Do a Good Job in the Prevention and Control of the Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Epidemic. Adhere to putting the people's life safety and health first, effectively enhance the sense of responsibility and urgency, fully implement the requirements of firm confidence, mutual assistance, scientific prevention and control, and precise measures, strengthen epidemic prevention and control measures within the courts, fully perform the trial function, strictly punish various crimes that hinder epidemic prevention and control, solidly implement measures for epidemic prevention and control and maintaining stability, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for resolutely winning the battle against the epidemic.

III. Optimize the Law-Based Business Environment and Actively Serve High-Quality Economic Development

9. Serve and Guarantee the Implementation of Major National Strategies. Precisely align with major strategies such as the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the construction of the Xiong'an New Area, the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River basin, and the comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up in Hainan, and actively provide judicial services and guarantees. Closely focus on the eight-character policy of "consolidate, enhance, enhance, and smooth," serve the deepening of supply-side structural reform, properly hear cases involving new technologies, new industries, and new business models, strengthen bankruptcy trial work, improve the market entity rescue and exit systems and mechanisms, lawfully and orderly promote the disposal of "zombie enterprises," and serve the construction of a modern economic system. Use judicial measures fully and well, stimulate innovation, entrepreneurship, and creativity, handle the relationship between digital rights protection and digital economy development, lawfully protect personal information, and serve and guarantee the development of the digital economy. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights, deeply advance the reform of the "three-in-one" trial mechanism, strengthen the construction of the intellectual property court system, strictly implement the punitive damages system, promote the formulation of a special procedure law for intellectual property litigation, strengthen trade secret protection, and serve innovation-driven development.

10. Create a More Stable, Fair, Transparent, and Predictable Law-Based Business Environment. Unswervingly implement the new development philosophy, better leverage the law's role in consolidating foundations, stabilizing expectations, and benefiting the long term, lawfully correct actions and practices that are not suitable for or even violate the new development philosophy, and serve the construction of a high-standard market system. Resolutely implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council on optimizing the business environment, intensify efforts around the three indicators of "enforcing contracts," "resolving insolvency," and "protecting minority investors," and make strenuous efforts to consolidate indicators, implement policies, and innovate. Deepen the reform of the administrative trial system and mechanism, support and supervise the government in administering according to law, strengthen the construction of an administrative dispute mediation work mechanism, enhance substantive resolution of administrative disputes, and serve the reform of "streamlining administration, delegating powers, improving regulation, and upgrading services."

11. Continuously Strengthen Judicial Protection of Property Rights. Adhere to taking strengthening judicial protection of property rights as a long-term key task, resolutely implement the requirements of comprehensive, lawful, and equal protection of property rights, treat all types of market entities equally, stabilize social expectations, and promote economic development. Strictly implement the "Opinions on Creating a Better Development Environment to Support the Reform and Development of Private Enterprises" issued by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, improve the legal environment for supporting the development of the private economy, lawfully guarantee private enterprises equal use of resource factors, equal participation in competition, and equal legal protection, assist private enterprises in reform, innovation, transformation, upgrading, and healthy development. Severely punish crimes against property rights, resolutely correct unjust and erroneous cases involving property rights, resolutely prevent the use of criminal means to intervene in economic disputes, resolutely prohibit the seizure of property exceeding the total amount, strictly distinguish between the lawful personal property of entrepreneurs and the proceeds of illegal crimes, and lawfully protect the lawful rights and interests of private enterprises and entrepreneurs.

12. Serve and Guarantee the Winning of the Three Critical Battles. Lawfully severely punish crimes of manufacturing and selling fake and inferior agricultural production materials and corruption crimes in the field of poverty alleviation, precisely respond to the judicial needs of people in deeply impoverished areas, implement the national three rural policies, ensure the smooth implementation of the rural revitalization strategy, and provide judicial services for the timely and complete completion of the poverty alleviation task. Strengthen research on new situations and new issues in the economic and financial fields, strengthen financial trial work, properly hear cases involving large numbers of people such as online lending and illegal pyramid schemes, severely crack down on economic crimes such as illegal fundraising, insider trading, and market manipulation, and resolutely hold the bottom line of preventing systemic risks. Improve the ecological environment damage compensation system, lawfully severely punish all types of environmental and resource crimes, promote the improvement of the ecological environment protection legal system, strengthen the construction of environmental and resource tribunals, and assist in winning the battles for blue skies, clear waters, and clean soil, and serve the construction of a beautiful China.

13. Serve and Guarantee High-Level Opening Up. Strengthen the construction of the foreign-related trial system and trial capability, promote the improvement of the system for the extraterritorial application of China's laws and the foreign-related economic and trade legal and rule systems, and enhance the judicial ability to protect the overseas safety and lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens and enterprises. Strengthen foreign-related commercial and maritime trial work, conscientiously implement the Foreign Investment Law and related judicial interpretations, give full play to the role of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court, improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for international commercial disputes, and serve the joint construction of the Belt and Road Initiative and the construction of pilot free trade zones and free trade ports, and assist in the construction of a new system for a higher-level open economy. Deepen international judicial exchanges and cooperation, actively participate in the reform of the global governance system and the formulation of international legal rules, and contribute more Chinese wisdom to safeguarding the multilateral trading system and international rule of law.

IV. Adhere to the People-Centered Development Thought and Continuously Deepen the Practice of Justice for the People

14. Strengthen Judicial Protection of People's Livelihood. In light of the key tasks of adhering to and improving the unified urban and rural people's livelihood security system, lawfully and properly hear cases involving employment, medical care, elderly care, labor remuneration, marriage and family, and other livelihood areas, and protect people's rights and interests. Adhere to strict and impartial justice, guarantee people's equal participation and equal development rights, and promote social fairness centered on fair rights, fair opportunities, and fair rules. Strengthen the work of state compensation adjudication and judicial assistance, and effectively enhance the level of rule of law, standardization, and refinement. Smooth and standardize channels for the expression of public demands, coordination of interests, and protection of rights and interests, improve the level of information application in petition cases involving litigation, and promote the lawful and standardized operation of petitions involving litigation, the lawful and rational expression of public demands, and the effective protection of lawful rights and interests.

15. Vigorously Promote the Core Values of Socialism. Adhere to the combination of governing the country according to law and governing the country with virtue, give full play to the guiding and evaluating role of judicial adjudication, promote truth, goodness, and beauty, punish falsehood, evil, and ugliness, and foster social righteousness. Conscientiously implement the outline for the implementation of patriotism education in the new era, lawfully punish acts that infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, damage or deface patriotic education venues and facilities, and glorify or beautify wars of aggression, and vigorously promote the spirit of patriotism. Conscientiously implement the outline for the implementation of the construction of civic morality in the new era, lawfully and properly hear cases involving basic social moral standards and codes of conduct, and establish a clear and correct moral orientation. Adhere to using fair adjudication to establish behavioral rules and lead social customs, make "small cases" produce big effects, and promote the cultivation and strengthening of the public's sense of responsibility, rule awareness, and rule of law awareness. Actively respond to public concerns, for cases of high social concern or where the public has vague understanding, strengthen the reasoning of judgments, clarify the points of contention, and present clear views, turning the trials of hot cases into vivid "open classes on the rule of law."

16. Comprehensively Advance the Construction of a One-Stop Diversified Dispute Resolution and Litigation Service System. Grasp implementation according to established deployments, promptly summarize and promote good experiences and practices from various places, use pilot projects to drive the comprehensive advancement of the modernization of the litigation service system of courts nationwide, and ensure that goals and tasks are achieved on schedule. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, adhere to placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront, improve the comprehensive mechanism for multiple prevention, mediation, and resolution of social conflicts and disputes, deepen the reform of the "division, mediation, adjudication, and trial" mechanism, strengthen the construction of litigation source governance mechanisms under the leadership of the Party Committee's political and legal affairs commission, and promote the prevention of conflicts and disputes at the source. Promote the improvement of the linkage work system of people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation, give full play to the advantage of mediation as an "Eastern experience" in preventing diseases. Adhere to the combination of online and offline approaches, smooth three-dimensional litigation service channels, strengthen the integrated construction of litigation services, provide comprehensive services such as multiple dispute resolution, case registration and filing, division, mediation, adjudication and trial, trial and execution assistance, circuit trials, and petitions involving litigation, and achieve one-stop handling, one-stop online handling, and one-stop telephone handling. Consolidate and deepen the achievements of the reform of the case registration and filing system, on the basis of achieving cross-regional case filing, advance the reform of deepening cross-regional case filing and litigation services, expand cross-regional litigation service functions, and improve the quality and efficiency of litigation services. In accordance with the work deployment for the pilot modernization of municipal social governance, strengthen the construction of people's courts, enhance the work capacity and level of people's courts, and promote the construction of a new pattern of grassroots social governance.

17. Improve and Strengthen the Long-Term Mechanism for Enforcement Work. Fully implement the spirit of Document No. 1 of the Central Committee for Comprehensively Governing the Country According to Law, promote systematic governance, comprehensive governance, and source governance to solve enforcement difficulties, conscientiously implement the assessment methods for the construction of peace, accelerate the implementation of the outline for enforcement work, and maintain the high-level operation of enforcement work. Focus on carrying out special enforcement actions to "consolidate the achievements of the basic resolution of enforcement difficulties," and comprehensively consolidate and enhance the achievements of "basic resolution of enforcement difficulties." Carefully summarize the experience in solving "enforcement difficulties," study and formulate opinions on deepening the reform of the civil enforcement system and mechanism, cooperate in the drafting and argumentation of the civil enforcement law, and promote the resolution of prominent problems in enforcement work. Actively participate in the construction of the social credit system, strengthen joint punishment for dishonesty, improve the classification management of credit punishment and the credit restoration mechanism, implement punishment precisely, and strengthen good-faith enforcement. Improve the positive incentive mechanism for automatic performance, increase the rewards for parties who voluntarily perform, and create a social atmosphere of respecting judgments and advocating integrity.

V. Deepen Judicial System Reform and Smart Court Construction, and Consolidate the Foundation for the Modernization of the Trial System and Trial Capability

18. Fully Implement the Judicial Accountability System. Correctly handle the relationship between adhering to Party leadership and the independent and impartial exercise of adjudicative power according to law in the reform of the judicial accountability system, and always adhere to the direction of reform of the socialist rule of law path with Chinese characteristics. Improve and implement the systems and mechanisms for the sole judge, collegial panel, and judicial committee, give full play to the leading and fundamental role of judges in case handling, establish a linkage mechanism between the presiding (specialized) judge meeting and the judicial committee, strictly implement the deliberation procedures and rules of the judicial committee, and better realize "let the adjudicator adjudicate, and let the adjudicator be responsible." Improve the list of rights and responsibilities of judicial personnel to ensure orderly delegation of power, scientific allocation of power, standardized use of power, and strict restriction of power. Adhere to the combination of delegation and supervision, improve the trial management system and the supervision and restriction mechanism for the exercise of trial power, refine the specific circumstances of the "four types of cases," and achieve automatic triggering of supervision, full traceability, real-time inquiry, and effective traceability. After the completion of the reform of the internal institutions of grassroots courts, the court presidents, division heads, and heads of internal institutions should focus on improving trial management and administrative management capabilities to better meet the needs of the situation and tasks. Implement the measures for resolving legal application differences, and promote the resolution of the problem of uniform adjudication standards from the institutional and mechanism level. Improve the judge disciplinary system, improve the accountability system system, accurately grasp the boundaries between trial defects and illegal trials, and support and guarantee judicial personnel in lawfully performing their duties.

19. Deepening comprehensive and coordinated reforms of the judicial system. We will strengthen the "look back" campaign for judicial system reform, systematically review and summarize the reform measures for the judicial system since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, consolidate and deepen mature and proven practices and promote their elevation to a system, step up efforts and accelerate progress on reform measures currently being advanced, and promptly introduce and effectively integrate supporting measures that need to follow up, so as to achieve new breakthroughs in systematic integration and coordinated efficiency of reforms. Persisting in a problem-oriented approach, we will further strengthen weak links, improve shortcomings, coordinate all parties to promote the implementation of comprehensive supporting measures, and promote the full "chemical reaction" of judicial system and mechanism reform measures in all aspects. We will proactively adapt to new situations and new requirements, accurately grasp the patterns of trial management, establish and improve the trial management system and mechanism, improve the performance evaluation indicator system, and effectively raise the scientific and standardized level of trial management. We will deepen the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trials, adhere to putting trial at the center, strictly implement the "three procedures" (three regulations governing the handling of criminal cases), accurately apply the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment, and promote the establishment of a sound working mechanism in which political and legal authorities each perform their duties, cooperate effectively, and check and balance each other. We will deepen the reform of the civil procedure system, advance the pilot reform of streamlining and diverting civil procedures, improve judicial confirmation procedures, small claims procedures, and summary procedures, expand the scope of application of single-judge trials, improve rules for electronic litigation, and promote the construction of a modern litigation procedure system. We will advance the reform of the judicial personnel system, improve the dynamic supplement and withdrawal mechanism for posts, promote the normalization of post selection, implement the supporting policies after the parallel implementation of civil service ranks and positions, increase the level of occupational protection for judicial personnel, and continuously optimize the allocation of judicial resources. We will improve the functional positioning of the four-level courts, advance the reform of internal institutions of people's courts, and build an optimized, coordinated, and efficient court institutional function system. We will strengthen the construction of circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, improve the circuit trial working mechanism, and fairly and efficiently adjudicate major administrative and civil and commercial cases across administrative regions in accordance with the law.

20. Comprehensively deepening the construction of smart courts. We will strengthen the overall design of the people's court information system, enhance the overall planning, standard specifications, and system development for smart court construction, build and make good use of the Supreme People's Court Smart Court Laboratory, fill the shortcomings in intelligent services, and advance the comprehensive construction of smart courts to deeper levels. We will comprehensively promote applications such as speech recognition in court hearings, intelligent proofreading of documents, and mandatory retrieval of similar cases, strive to overcome a number of key technologies centered on artificial intelligence, and continuously deepen the construction of smart trials. We will comprehensively upgrade the enforcement case handling platform, open up data interfaces between trial and enforcement case handling platforms, and continue to exert efforts in the informatization construction of enforcement management, online asset investigation, joint disciplinary actions, and judicial auctions, thereby improving the level of smart enforcement. We will aggregate dispute resolution resources from all parties and various litigation service functions, promote online mediation, online arbitration, and online litigation, achieve unified management and dispute resolution through a single network, and build a globally leading smart litigation service system. We will focus on improving the capabilities of data aggregation, management, analysis, and service, give full play to the important role of judicial big data in social governance, and better leverage the advantages of smart management. We will improve the working mechanism for publishing judgment documents, promote the disclosure of trial process information, refine personal information protection measures, and raise the level of informatization, standardization, and normalization of judicial openness.

21. Accelerating the exploration of new models for Internet justice. We will conscientiously summarize the construction experience of the Beijing, Hangzhou, and Guangzhou Internet Courts, conduct in-depth research on the new characteristics and trends of Internet disputes, and actively explore Internet trial mechanisms and adjudication rules. We will deepen the construction and pilot application of mobile micro-courts, allowing parties and judges to fully experience the convenience of "litigation at fingertips and case handling in the palm." We will strengthen the construction of a unified blockchain platform for people's courts, accelerate breakthroughs in blockchain technology and the implementation of application scenarios, and form a national unified people's court blockchain application system. We will strengthen international exchanges and cooperation in the field of Internet rule of law, actively participate in the formulation of international rules, and contribute more Chinese solutions to the progress of Internet rule of law in the world.

6. Vigorously strengthening team building, building a court team that the Party and the people trust, rely on, and can rest assured.

22. Always put the Party's political construction first. We will thoroughly implement the opinions on strengthening the Party's political construction, educate and guide the vast number of police officers to continuously improve their political stance and political capabilities. We will strengthen ideological tempering and political training, firm up ideals and convictions, and ensure a clear attitude and firm stance on major issues of principle. We will adhere to the principle of the Party managing cadres, always put political standards first, take institutional execution and governance capacity as important criteria for cadre selection, appointment, assessment, and evaluation, and cultivate a clean and upright political ecology. We will conscientiously implement the Regulations on the Work of CPC Branches (for Trial Implementation), deeply implement the project to enhance the organizational strength of grassroots Party organizations, comprehensively promote the standardization and normalization of branch construction, and strive to solve problems such as weak and lax grassroots Party organizations. Relying closely on the leadership of Party committees at all levels, we will promote the resolution of institutional, mechanism, and policy issues that constrain the work of courts, and effectively strengthen the construction of leadership teams and staff in people's courts.

23. Vigorously rectifying issues identified by inspection. We will conscientiously implement the feedback opinions of the Central Inspection Team on the inspection of the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, earnestly take the political perspective to grasp the rectification of inspection issues and the application of results, and implement the rectification work plan and the comprehensive and special rectification ledgers item by item, doing a solid job of the "second half of the article." In response to the problems revealed by the inspection, we will conscientiously conduct self-examination, hold a special democratic life meeting on inspection rectification, deeply analyze the causes, formulate rectification measures, and make genuine and thorough rectifications, with the most resolute attitude and the most powerful measures to ensure full implementation. We will persist in combining inspection rectification with consolidating and expanding the results of the thematic education, with deepening judicial system reform, and with strengthening daily supervision and management, and with an uplifting spirit, promote the Party building, trial enforcement, judicial reform, and team building of people's courts to a new level, and actively create "model organs that reassure the Party Central Committee and satisfy the people."

24. Strengthening capacity building. We will strengthen practical training and professional training, emphasize practical, practical, and effective orientation, and effectively enhance the ability of police officers to apply legal policies, prevent and control risks, work with the masses, apply technology, and guide public opinion, so that the thinking, concepts, and abilities of the vast number of police officers truly enter the new era. We will conscientiously implement the Regulations on Cadre Education and Training Work, innovate education and training models, and guide and promote police officers to timely supplement their skill shortcomings, update their knowledge systems, and improve their work capabilities. We will strengthen research on the cohesive application of the Civil Code and study and training work to ensure the orderly implementation of the Civil Code. We will strengthen the cultivation of high-level and expert-type trial talents, and intensify efforts to cultivate and reserve judicial talents in areas such as intellectual property, foreign-related matters, environmental resources, the Internet, finance, and bankruptcy. We will strengthen the cultural construction of people's courts, implement the project of creating court cultural products, and provide value guidance, cultural cohesion, and spiritual impetus for the construction of court teams. We will focus on improving the capacity and level of judicial news and public opinion work, vigorously publicize the vivid practice of General Secretary Xi Jinping's new concepts, new ideas, and new strategies for governing the country according to the law in people's courts, publicize the actual effectiveness of people's courts in serving the overall situation, justice for the people, and fair justice, and publicize the righteous spirit and uplifting spirit of the new era's people's judges who are loyal, clean, responsible, punishing evil and promoting good, and enforcing the law with integrity. We will strengthen professional ethics construction, make strengthening fair and honest professional ethics a required course, educate and guide police officers to consciously use Party discipline, state laws, and professional ethics to restrain themselves, and realize that injustice and dishonesty are the greatest shame, creating a clean and honest atmosphere in the national courts where impartiality, fair administration of justice, neutrality, and neither wronging nor conniving are honored, and entrustment and abuse of power for personal gain are shamed. We will strengthen investigation and research, innovate research forms, improve research capacity and level, and serve scientific decision-making.

25. Adhering to comprehensive strict governance of the Party, strict governance of the court, and strict management. We will conscientiously study and implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, carry out in-depth team education and rectification, consistently and unswervingly implement the requirements of comprehensive strict governance of the Party, strictly implement the main responsibility of comprehensive strict governance of the Party, deepen tackling both symptoms and root causes, strengthen the deterrence of not daring to be corrupt, strengthen the cage of not being able to be corrupt, enhance the consciousness of not wanting to be corrupt, and with a new style, usher in a new situation for the Party building and all work of people's courts. We will strictly implement the spirit of the Central Committee's Eight-Point Regulation and its implementation rules, strictly guard against formalism and bureaucracy, and resolutely prevent the resurgence of the "four forms of decadence." We will strictly implement the "Three Regulations" and other ironclad rules and prohibitions to prevent interference in judicial proceedings, issue concrete and tough measures, and make the system for preventing interference in judicial proceedings truly an "electrified high-voltage line." We will deeply learn the lessons from serious violations of discipline and law by Wang Linqing and others, educate and guide police officers to enhance their awareness of discipline and law, and effectively prevent and solve the problem of "darkness under the lamp." We will persist in punishing judicial corruption with zero tolerance, resolutely eliminate the black sheep, and ensure fair and honest justice. We will persist in combining strict management with care, always adhere to the main tone of "strictness," be good at making "three distinctions" (distinguishing between mistakes due to lack of experience, pilot reforms, and corruption), form a new atmosphere of pragmatism, integrity, and honesty, strengthen the guarantee for police officers to perform their duties, motivate cadres to take responsibility and act, and let police officers handle cases impartially, perform their duties in accordance with the law, and work with peace of mind.

7. Consciously accepting supervision and continuously improving the work of people's courts.

26. Strengthening liaison with deputies to the National People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. We will enhance the awareness of accepting supervision, improve the mechanism for communication and liaison with deputies and members, innovate methods of liaison and communication, carry out efficient and convenient communication and liaison work, and unblock channels for public opinion. We will actively invite deputies to inspect court work, attend conferences, and observe court hearings, and earnestly listen to their opinions and suggestions on court work. We will actively visit and receive members of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, strengthen communication with democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages, and widely adopt opinions from all sides.

27. Seriously handling deputies' suggestions and CPPCC proposals. We will earnestly handle the suggestions of deputies of the National People's Congress and the proposals of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, establish and improve work ledgers, refine division of labor plans, strengthen supervision and inspection, promptly feedback the progress and results of handling to deputies and members, and actively strive for their understanding and support.

28. Earnestly preparing for the special report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on strengthening civil trial work by people's courts and legally serving and ensuring the sustained and healthy development of the economy and society. We will conscientiously summarize the experience of civil and commercial trial work in recent years, take the implementation of the Civil Code as an opportunity, actively carry out investigation and research, timely put forward opinions and suggestions, conscientiously make preparations for the special report, and take the special report as an opportunity to promote the improvement of the capacity and level of civil and commercial trial work.

People's courts at all levels shall, based on this outline and in light of actual work, decompose tasks, strictly implement work, and promote all work such as Party building, trial enforcement, judicial reform, and team building to a new level, effectively fulfill the duties and tasks of maintaining national political security, ensuring overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and ensuring the people's peaceful life, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for securing a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and winning the battle against poverty.
